passages.accepted_text: Grade retention changes a student's educational trajectory and the peer group in which schooling continues. Its consequences are not uniform: reviews document contrasting findings across settings, research designs and comparison groups. Some studies find lower subsequent achievement among retained students than among peers who progress to the next grade \citep{allen,goos}. Others identify short-term academic gains, particularly relative to younger classmates in the repeated grade, although these advantages tend to fade \citep{allen,goos}. Across these different comparisons, the average effect is close to zero \citep{goos}.
